status: plan frozen 2026-10-05 before any COPASI import, simulation or fit
design_status: Retrospective cross-solver check of a fit that already informed development. It validates no biology, predicts nothing new and is never blind or independent.
question: Does an independent simulator and optimiser (COPASI) reproduce FungMod's all-condition least-squares optimum of the registry hydrolysis candidate on the Gelain 2020 cellulose loadings when both work on the same PEtab problem?

problem.model: M0_baseline of the model-criticism plan: the registry case trichoderma_harzianum_p49p11 x cellulose_celufloc_200 (six generic processes) at the three environments of the Bayesian study plan
problem.objective: sum over the 96 measurements of ((simulation - measurement) / sigma)^2 with sigma = each observable's maximum over the three loadings; this is twice the stage A 'primary' least-squares cost of the criticism plan, so FungMod's optimum is already recorded
problem.parameters: the nine registry symbols gelain_hydrolysis_* with the criticism plan's M0 bounds, PEtab scale log10; nominal values are the stage A M0 primary all-condition fit
problem.export: fungal_model.standards.conditions_to_petab: PEtab v1 with one SBML L3V2 model whose parameter-bound yield coefficients are separate reactions and whose assay-activity units are named dimensionless unit definitions; the cellulose loading is a condition-table column

reference_fit.note: FungMod's optimum under the criticism plan's amendment 3 (log-space difference step 1e-3, tolerances 1e-10, restarts): scipy least_squares in log space, five starts, cost 1.9880359493158402 (objective 3.9760718986316803)

copasi.importer: copasi-petab-importer (PEtabConverter) into a COPASI file; basico drives COPASI
copasi.weight_correction: COPASI weights a dependent column by a multiplier of the squared residual and the importer stores sigma there; the runner rewrites every weight to 1/sigma^2 and switches off per-experiment weight normalisation before any evaluation, and records both values
copasi.parameter_space: linear (the importer ignores the PEtab log10 scale); the optimum is the same point
copasi.local_fit: one Levenberg-Marquardt run from the nominal (FungMod) values
copasi.start_distribution: log-uniform within the bounds, drawn by numpy default_rng(seed)
copasi.objective_evaluation: every optimum is re-evaluated with COPASI time courses on the PEtab objective; COPASI's internal objective is recorded alongside

simulation_agreement.meaning: at the nominal values COPASI's time courses and FungMod's compiled-core predictions differ by less than 1e-4 of each observable's sigma at every measurement, and the two objectives agree to 1e-5

optimum_agreement.meaning: COPASI's best objective over the local fit and the random starts is within 0.1 percent of FungMod's; lower by more than that is a FungMod optimiser shortfall and is reported as such

gates.parameter_report: the relative difference of every parameter between COPASI's best optimum and FungMod's reference is reported, not gated: stage A found two weakly determined directions (condition number 4.8e4) along which equally good optima differ

outcomes.copasi_improves: COPASI finds an objective lower than FungMod's by more than the optimum tolerance; reported as a FungMod optimiser shortfall with the parameter values
outcomes.not_reproduced: any other failure, reported with the numbers

claims_excluded: that the optimum is unique or the parameters identified (see the criticism and Bayesian studies)
any statement about models other than M0_baseline

amendments.reason: sources.criticism_plan.sha256 and sources.reference_fit (sha256 and note) updated before any re-run, because the criticism plan's amendment 3 (digest 9897ab11) added the stage A optimiser settings that this study's first run (outcome copasi_improves under a0f8abe9) showed to be missing, and stage A was re-run under them; the reference fit is the new M0_baseline primary all-condition fit. The question, the problem, the COPASI settings, the gates and the outcome vocabulary are unchanged; the reproduction is re-run under this digest and the earlier result files are replaced.

amendment_rule: any change to this file after freezing is a dated entry in 'amendments' with its reason, recorded before the affected run; the ledger records the file's sha256 at freezing and after each amendment
